features: 2.8-12 mm motorized zoom (4.2x optical), auto-focus, remote zoom/focus
VCA: tripwire, intrusion, face detection, object counting
SD-card edge recording with in-browser playback
release_notes: Archived/EOL Advanced-line outdoor IP tube 6 MPx (2017 generation, Sony STARVIS platform). Now verified against the official ABUS product-sheet datasheet: 1/1.8" Sony Exmor R STARVIS CMOS, 3072x2048 @ 24 fps (25 fps at 3072x1728), 2.8-12 mm motor-zoom (4.2x optical) auto-focus, 5 IR LEDs up to 50 m, DWDR, decentralized VCA (tripwire / intrusion / face detection / object counting), H.264/MJPEG, PoE 802.3at + 12V DC (12 W), 390x160x160 mm, -30 to 60 °C, min illum color 0.014 lx. Note: the datasheet's tech-data table lists IP67 while its marketing text says IP66 — recorded IP67 per the spec table. Net weight not stated on the sheet (only gross 2.45 kg); aperture not stated. Both omitted.

frigate.notes: 2017 Advanced line (Sony platform, not Hikvision OEM) — RTSP path undocumented. Use go2rtc ONVIF autodiscovery (onvif://{user}:{pass}@{ip}) to resolve the stream URL, or check the camera web UI.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic ONVIF/RTSP with 'Find/inspect' to discover the stream path.
